theorems.name: Submission.idtp_caf_lipschitz_localization
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Z : Set (Euclid P)) (F : Euclid P → Euclid n), IsOpen Z → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 F Z → ∃ (V Zs : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)) (G : ℕ → Euclid P → Euclid n), (∀ l, IsOpen (V l)) ∧ (∀ l, V l ⊆ Z) ∧ (∀ l, MeasurableSet (Zs l)) ∧ (∀ l, Zs l ⊆ V l) ∧ Pairwise (fun l l' => Disjoint (Zs l) (Zs l')) ∧ (⋃ l, Zs l) = Z ∧ (∀ l, ∃ K : NNReal, LipschitzWith K (G l)) ∧ ∀ l, EqOn F (G l) (V l)
